description: The NON-DERIVABLE half of the source trust census (src/sources/source_census.py, Batch 3 Unit A): provider identity, evidence basis, recorded ancestry/dependence and recorded source-specific defects. Everything derivable (registration, families, weights, freshness, clocks, coverage, archive depth) is computed from canonical state at census time and must NOT be copied here. Every entry carries evidence pointers (repo paths that exist) and a classification. 'proven' = established by code, payload structure or the vendor's own published statement recorded in the repo. 'measured' = a statistic measured on real boards; it is DEPENDENCE, never common ancestry. 'suspected' = plausible ancestry with no proof; kept separate from proven on purpose. Nothing here decides a value or a weight. Pairs are reconciled into exactly four categories (categories / pairReconciliation; one owner with src/sources/source_census.py::LINEAGE_CATEGORIES): a measurement never becomes PROVEN_COMMON_ANCESTRY, INDEPENDENT_NO_EVIDENCE is absence of evidence, and a null category is UNKNOWN with its reason. Batch 3 Unit G refresh: docs/sources/integrity/INTEGRITY_SWEEP_2026-10-01.md. D2 follow-up (OTC vs the Hill trainers, multi-snapshot; relation statistics are dated histories): docs/sources/integrity/OTC_LINEAGE_REMEASURE_2026-10-01.md.

categories.PROVEN_COMMON_ANCESTRY: documented / verified that one provider derives from the other (vendor statement, payload structure or code); needs a supporting 'proven' relation
categories.MEASURED_DEPENDENCE: measured statistical dependence with method, window, n and pinned evidence; NOT proof of ancestry
categories.SUSPECTED_DEPENDENCE: plausible but unmeasured, or measured too weakly to support MEASURED_DEPENDENCE
categories.INDEPENDENT_NO_EVIDENCE: no evidence of dependence: absence of evidence, never proven independence

evidenceBases.crowd_trade_market: values implied by a crowd of user trades / trade calculator usage
evidenceBases.trade_derived: values derived from a large set of completed trades
evidenceBases.expert_consensus: a panel or consensus of experts
evidenceBases.publisher_board: one publisher's hand-maintained board, panel composition not stated
evidenceBases.derived_aggregate: re-publishes or aggregates other providers' values
evidenceBases.unknown: methodology not established by repo evidence

These boards vote as RANKS but train the OFFENSE Hill master through their NATIVE values, an unmeasured second channel of influence over every rank source (Hill audit H3; owned by Batch 3 Unit D).

Three of four OFFENSE Hill holdouts share measured lineage or dependence with training evidence (Fantasy Navigator / KTC, PFK / KTC, FantasyCalc / Dynasty Daddy), so the holdout is not independent evidence (Hill audit H5/H6; owned by Batch 3 Unit D).

Dual-eligible edge rushers listed on both the DL and LB pages and absent from the combined page are written twice with different effective ranks (15 players on the 2026-09-30 board, 16 on 2026-09-23; e.g. Dallas Turner LB 89 and DL 118). No vote changes today: the contract serves the better effective rank. FIX DEFERRED (Unit G review): de-duplicating in the fetcher is not freshness-neutral. dataset_integrity.parse_board keys the second occurrence as 'name#2', so dropping them removes 15 of 299 rows (5%), which clears broadChange (minRows 5, minFraction 0.02): the first fetch after the fix would log a broad publication the vendor never made, reset lastBroadDatasetChangeAt, raise the freshness weight and add a false event to cadence/style history. The dataset-state owner has no one-time representation-change marker. Display metadata would also move (data_contract._select_fp_meta stamps LB/89 instead of DL/118 on DL-listed rows; sourceAudit.ambiguous flips to false). Land the dedupe together with a freshness-neutral mechanism; strict-xfail tests pin the pending fix.

A QB chart without 'SF Value' fell back to 'Trade Value' (the 1QB number) and a TE chart without 'TEP Value' to the non-premium number, per ROW, so a renamed or blank cell silently mixed formats under a source declared superflex + TE-premium. Latent (the 2026-10 charts carry both columns). FIXED: the format column is chosen once per chart from the header; QB/TE without it raise and the run preserves last-good; a blank format cell is dropped, never backfilled. These refusals exit 2 (schema regression). Unit G review: a position chart missing from the article (exit 2) or whose CSV fetch fails (exit 1) also refuses, where the run used to drop that whole position and still write if 225+ rows remained, which the dataset state would have read as a broad publication.

24 players absent from the FantasyPros combined IDP page (which ranks 119) are interpolated to effective ranks 89-119 from a positional page, i.e. ahead of players the vendor's own combined board did rank. Whether absence from the combined page implies rank > 119 is a methodology question (owner).

The captured CSV carries 'Demario Douglas' (API sheet) and 'DeMario Douglas' (scraper autocomplete path) with the same value: the autocomplete fallback keys FULL_DATA by the scraper's own spelling without a case-insensitive check. No value impact (the contract keeps the best of one canonical key).
